overview.about: The Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF) is one of the world's largest public film festivals and a crucial launchpad for the awards season, held each September. Its People's Choice Award, voted by audiences, has become a reliable early predictor of Oscar success.
overview.nextEvent: The next Toronto International Film Festival runs in September in Toronto. Unusually audience-focused, it premieres many of the year's Oscar contenders, and its People's Choice Award is closely watched across the industry.
